_readme: WHY THIS FILE EXISTS (three sources, one answer per point) - same rules as gis/sport-patch-2025-10.json:
1. BASE = IAA GIS 2023a (gis/cvfr.json). The only machine-readable source: points, route lines, status. It is never edited.
The IAA has not published a newer GIS; the newest official source is the printed CVFR chart (Oct 2025).
2. POINTS = the table on the back page of the Oct 2025 CVFR chart (code, Hebrew name, type, coordinates).
Used ONLY where the GIS lacks a point or disagrees with the chart. The other 197 GIS CVFR points already match the table within 40 m.
3. ROUTES = the drawing on the Oct 2025 chart (which points are joined, line style, printed distance).
A straight leg is a straight line between its points. A leg that bends on the chart (AFULA-EITAN) is TRACED from the chart:
the crop is pinned to 5 table points (error under 100 m) and the green line is followed pixel by pixel.
The printed distance is a CHECK: the parser refuses a leg (Q circle + flag) if its length differs from the
printed distance by more than 0.3 NM (a typo, or a bent leg drawn as straight).
NAMING: the chart's code and Hebrew name are the official ones; other codes are kept as aliases.
WITHDRAWN (not deleted): points / legs in the GIS but no longer on the 2025 chart are hidden wherever a pilot plans or
looks (map layers, route drawing, waypoint names); a NOTAM that names one is still DRAWN and FLAGGED 'לבדיקה'.
PRIORITY: where this file and the GIS both hold a point, this file wins. Drop this file when the IAA publishes a new GIS.
Separate from the sport patch on purpose: separate chart, separate date, and the same code can differ between the
two charts (HATRU here = TZHTR on the sport chart; DUGIT sits 780 m apart on the two official charts).
Checked by Eli against the chart, 2026-09-29.
